productBrief: cortex: a synthetic focus group platform where AI personas with persistent memory debate your product. Personas are iNFTs on 0G Storage, talk over AXL P2P mesh, get verified by TeeML, and grow smarter each session. No recruiting, no scheduling — run a 9-turn focus group in minutes.
contradictions: use of blockchain for verification vs. skepticism about edge case handling
painPoints: lack of concrete data on performance
predictability and potential biases in synthetic persona interactions
opportunities: integrating blockchain for verification and transparency
prioritizing validation against real user feedback
enhancing the models to handle edge cases and reduce biases
rawSummary: Panelists recognized the innovative aspect of cortex but expressed concerns about the credibility and scalability of synthetic personas versus real users, as well as the potential for predictability and biases. They suggested prioritizing validation against real user feedback and integrating blockchain for transparency and ethical verification.
